scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with buildings on both sides, including a large white building with many windows and balconies on the left, and a bus stop with a green bus parked in front of it on the right. The street is paved with gray cobblestones and has a few cars and motorcycles parked along the side. There are also some pedestrians walking around, including a woman in a brown coat and a man in a black jacket. The sky is blue with a few white clouds.

The building on the right is taller and has a more modern design with a flat roof and a large window on the top floor. There are several other buildings in the background, including a tall building with a pointed roof.
